verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents a 'Selecting an Audit Partner' dashboard action, which suggests auditors can be chosen through the product. Its quickstart also says you can collaborate with your auditor in-platform. The evidence is only a page title plus a generic collaboration claim, and it shows nothing about whether the auditors are vetted or what the booking flow looks like. missing for 10: description of a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm, actual booking/engagement workflow, published audit timeline expectations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
